verification.footprint: AB-R-0600: --ic-spot25, LTX-2.5 bf16, 768x448x121, seed 42, 2026-10-19, ltx-2-mlx-swift 22f8553 (the decode fix, AB-T-0339): activation excluding the prompt-encoder phases 17.59 / 17.57 GB on two runs with the adapter and a 768x448x121 talking-face clip (lipdub-ref-talking-photoreal) whose own 5.0 s audio track is the dub, vs 10.65 GB, the smallest of three readings of the same harness's no-adapter control arm = 1.652, declared 1.66. Binding phase: denoise 56.25 GB (reference encode 51.2-52.5, audio reference 40.1; decode 52.3-52.5). The prompt encode (DiT resident + bf16 Gemma-4, ~63 GB in every arm) is excluded: identical across arms and never DiT-co-resident in the engine. Supersedes AB-R-0598, whose figure was the decode before the fix. One geometry; the package runs IC one stage at target resolution whatever runtime.stage2 says. residentBytes = the bf16 file, which the DiT's low-rank add keeps as loaded.
